title: Why Smart Workers Get Stuck at Level 2
description:
Most people think doubling their salary means working harder, staying later, and finally getting that promotion.

That’s Level 1 thinking.

This video breaks down the 4 levels of workers and not by title, but by how the system actually treats them.

Only one of these levels escapes the salary ceiling.

Once you see where you’re operating, it’s hard to unsee.

Contents: 
00:00 - Intro 
00:24 - Level 1 
03:59 - Level 2 
06:00 - Level 3 
07:29 - Level 4
